analysis: Fixed-cohort adaptation of RBS notebook node-embedding readout
checkpoint_variant: published example; not exact reported-accuracy reproduction
pooling: histograms pool graph-node pairs; estimates average graph means

definitions.walk_frontier: Nodes reachable by a walk of exactly k edges; may overlap earlier frontiers
definitions.reachable_up_to_k: Union of walk frontiers from 0 through k
definitions.not_reached_up_to_k: Present graph nodes outside reachable_up_to_k; can include later-reachable nodes
definitions.reference_optimal: Dataset neighbor_k, solver-verified nodes at depth k on shortest root-to-target paths

limitations: Nested node categories are not independent groups
Embedding readout is not proof of causal use or BFS
The mapping from latent step to graph depth follows the notebook and must be tested later
Cosine and bootstrap analysis are additions to the notebook
